text: 所以成不了大事，运气好成了也会因为目光短浅败光。
en: So they never achieve anything great, and even if they luck into success, they'll squander it all through short-sightedness.

text: 典型反面案例就是东子，要是娶的是董明珠，会落得现在这样吗
en: Dongzi is the classic counter-example — if he had married Mingzhu Dong, would he have ended up like this?

text: 因为咱们的优质男性不是马克龙，不喜欢姐弟恋。
en: Because our quality men aren't Macron — they don't care for relationships where the woman is older.

text: 前两天我和老妈闲聊，说有个熟人的女儿36岁还没嫁出去，而且根本不想找对象，但是皇帝不急急死太监，她的爹妈急啊，眼瞅着一朵花快变成果子了，赶紧找下家啊，就到处托人，见谁托谁，为了女儿操碎了心但没看到任何曙光。
en: The other day I was chatting with my mum, and mentioned that an acquaintance's daughter is 36 and still unmarried, and has absolutely no wish to find a partner. But while the emperor isn't worried, the eunuch is worried to death — her parents are in a panic. Watching a flower about to turn into fruit, they're eager to find her a next match, so they ask everyone they can, buttonholing whoever they meet. They've worn their hearts out for their daughter but haven't seen a glimmer of hope.

text: 他看中了一位40岁优质男，托人牵线搭桥，结果优质男一口回绝: 我没结婚，但我不想找对象，就爱单着！
en: She set her sights on a quality 40-year-old man and asked someone to act as a matchmaker, but the man refused point-blank: 'I've never married, but I don't want to find a partner — I just love being single!'

text: 我妈听了就嘲笑，这么大年纪还想找没离过婚的，做梦吧！
en: My mum scoffed when she heard this: at that age still wanting to find someone who's never been divorced? In your dreams!

text: 我26岁结婚27都生下你了，劝她赶紧把目标调整到离婚无孩中年男，还有那么一点可能性。
en: I got married at 26 and had you by 27, so I advised her to shift her target quickly to a divorced, childless middle-aged man — at least then there's a slim chance.

text: 话说得难听，但我无言以对，女人都这么想，何况男人呼？
en: What she said was harsh, but I was lost for words — if women think this way, how much more so men?

text: 也不是不能考虑吧？
en: It's not that it can't be considered, is it?

text: 顺便问一下40岁女：妳有房吗？
en: By the way, a question for the 40-year-old woman: do you own a property?

text: 有车吗？
en: A car?

text: 有存款吗？
en: Savings?

text: 四十岁的女人不好骗了啊，无论是金钱方面，还是生活方面，都不太好骗，主要还是四十岁的女人学会看清现实是什么了，不会被甜言蜜语所欺骗，而且说实话，一个四十岁的女人而且情史丰富的话，那还真的很难满足她，毕竟不是没有经验的小女生了！
en: Forty-year-old women are no longer easy to deceive — whether it comes to money or to life, they're not easily taken in. The main thing is that forty-year-old women have learned to see reality for what it is, and won't be fooled by sweet talk. And to be honest, a forty-year-old woman with a rich romantic history is genuinely hard to satisfy, for she is no longer an inexperienced young girl!

text: 40岁男大学老师的话可以参考一下
en: The words of a 40-year-old male university teacher are worth considering.

text: 我本科学校的一位男数学老师42没对象，给他介绍38的他嫌老。
en: A male maths teacher at my undergraduate university was 42 with no partner; when they introduced him to a 38-year-old, he thought she was too old.

text: 他说：男的六十岁还能生孩子呢。
en: He said: men can still father children at sixty.

text: 我今年还真随了一个40多岁的份子，这个人是我部门另外一个科室的经理，收入不算特别高，但一个人活肯定爽的飞起，我都不理解40多岁还结什么婚？
en: This year I actually attended a wedding and gave a red envelope for someone in his forties — he's a manager in another section of my department. His income isn't especially high, but living alone he must be having the time of his life. I simply don't understand why someone over forty would still get married.

text: 生完孩子45了，都大后期了，你出一中期装备，后来一看新娘27岁，而且他们还谈了一年多，也就是说女孩在25岁时就和这个40岁中登谈上了。
en: By the time the child is born she's 45 — that's deep into the late game. You've only just bought your mid-game kit, and then it turns out the bride was 27, and they'd been together for over a year — meaning the girl got together with this 40-year-old middle-aged man when she was only 25.

text: 我一亲戚家的孩子，比我大一岁，90年代末的时候考上了航天大学。
en: A child of a relative of mine, one year older than me, got into Aerospace University in the late 1990s.

text: 他家是农村的，曾经处了个女朋友，是北京本地的，应该是高中毕业的。
en: His family was from the countryside; he once had a girlfriend who was a local Beijinger, probably a high-school graduate.

text: 两个人处了几年，女朋友总是嫌他是农村的，没出息，最后分手了。
en: The two were together for a few years; the girlfriend always looked down on him for being from the countryside and lacking ambition, and in the end they broke up.

text: 后来那个表哥就一直单着，整天忙着事业，后来去了外企当高管。
en: After that, that cousin stayed single, busy with his career all day, and later went to work at a foreign company as a senior executive.

text: 零几年的时候，年薪就差不多100多万了，在北京、上海都买了房子。
en: Around the early 2000s his annual salary was already around a million-plus, and he bought properties in both Beijing and Shanghai.

text: 等到他40岁的时候，已经算是事业有成了，之前的前女友也一直没找到合适的，想跟他复合，被拒绝了。
en: By the time he turned 40, he had already made a success of his career. His former girlfriend had never found anyone suitable, wanted to get back together with him, and was refused.

text: 这个表哥一直到45岁才结婚，他原本想找一个年龄差不多的，三十七八岁到40岁之间的。
en: This cousin didn't marry until he was 45. He had originally wanted to find someone around his own age, between thirty-seven or eight and forty.

text: 然而，在这个年龄段的要求一个比一个离谱。
en: Yet, within that age range, the demands grew more absurd one after another.

text: 有的一听说他年薪百万，张嘴就敢要50万彩礼，还要一套自己加名的房子，也不知道她们哪儿来的自信和勇气。
en: Some, on hearing his million-yuan salary, would open their mouths and dare to demand a 500,000-yuan bride price, plus a flat in their own name — who knows where they got such confidence and nerve.

text: 当年表哥是回老家相亲的，因为城市里和他年龄相仿的单身的女性，如果是事业有成的，那基本上就特别强势，
en: Back then the cousin went back to his hometown to meet prospective partners, because the single women in the city around his age, if they had successful careers, were basically extremely domineering,

text: 即便是没什么事业的，总感觉性格难以相处。
en: and even those without much of a career always seemed difficult to get along with.

text: 他是到了年龄突然之间就特想成家，想有个孩子的，于是老家的亲戚朋友都帮着张罗介绍对象。
en: He was someone who, upon reaching a certain age, suddenly badly wanted to settle down and have a child, so the relatives and friends back home all helped arrange introductions.

text: 当时众多相亲对象当中有一个刚28岁的，是个女老师。
en: Among the many candidates at the time, there was one who had just turned 28, a female teacher.

text: 表哥觉得年龄差的太多，差了整整17岁，所以压根就没去看，直接就回绝了。
en: The cousin felt the age gap was too large — a full 17 years — so he didn't go to see her at all and refused outright.

text: 过年那段时间看了几个年龄差不多40岁左右的，给他看得直恼火，全都是张嘴几十万彩礼，要房子，还有的是离异带娃的。
en: During the New Year period he met a few who were around 40, and they made him furious — every one of them demanded hundreds of thousands in bride price, wanted a flat, and some were divorced with children.

text: 最后干脆不看，直接回北京了。
en: In the end he simply stopped meeting anyone and went straight back to Beijing.

text: 结果那个28岁的女老师，听说以后想方设法要到了表哥北京的地址，她妈妈陪着，直接就找到了表哥的家。
en: As it turned out, that 28-year-old teacher, after hearing about it, went to great lengths to get the cousin's Beijing address, and with her mother accompanying her, turned up directly at the cousin's home.

text: 然后娘俩就以到北京探亲，没地方住为名，在表哥家住下了。
en: Then the mother and daughter, on the pretext of visiting relatives in Beijing with nowhere to stay, moved in with the cousin.

text: 女的要追男的就简单了，并且这女的不要彩礼，不要房子，也不需要加名什么的，就是奔着结婚，结婚以后马上要生孩子去的。
en: When a woman pursues a man it is straightforward, and this woman wanted no bride price, no flat, no name on the deeds or anything — she was simply set on marriage, and on having children right after the wedding.

text: 现在他们孩子都有两个了。
en: Now they already have two children.

text: 其实不是所有的男人都喜欢年轻女孩的，我所认识的相当一部分，如果是以结婚为目的的话，还是喜欢选择和自己年龄相仿的。
en: Actually, not all men like young girls; a fair number of those I know, if their aim is marriage, still prefer to choose someone around their own age.

text: 毕竟是居家过日子，年龄差不多的才有共同语言。
en: After all, it's about running a household together; only those of similar age share common ground.

text: 找太年轻的，除了看着好看以外，其他真的没什么优势，没有共同语言，整天得像个孩子一样哄着，真的很累。
en: Finding someone too young, apart from being pleasant to look at, has no real advantage — no common ground, and you have to coax them like a child all day long, which is truly exhausting.

text: 这一点我就是深有感触的。
en: I feel this keenly myself.

text: 我老婆比我小十岁，虽然感情确实很好，但是真聊不到一起来。
en: My wife is ten years younger than me; although we genuinely love each other, we really can't talk on the same wavelength.

text: 但是为什么那么多男的相亲，最后的结果还是找了个年轻的呢？
en: But why is it that so many men, after going through matchmaking, still end up with a younger woman?

text: 原因很简单，因为越是年轻的，要求反而没那么多。
en: The reason is simple: the younger they are, the fewer demands they tend to make.

text: 我30岁的时候，那时候相亲，最开始找的都是30岁左右的，也都是一个要求比一个离谱。
en: When I was 30 and going through matchmaking, the ones I first looked at were all around 30, and their demands were also more absurd one after another.

text: 而我老婆，却什么都不要，也愿意跟我。
en: Yet my wife wanted nothing at all, and was still willing to be with me.

text: 不是40岁的男，不考虑40岁的女，而是绝大多数的40岁的男人，都无法满足40岁的女所提出的各种要求。
en: It's not that 40-year-old men won't consider 40-year-old women; rather, the vast majority of 40-year-old men simply cannot meet the various demands that 40-year-old women put forward.

text: 那问问那些40岁的女性，有考虑过和她同年龄但收入一般的男性吗？
en: So ask those 40-year-old women: have they ever considered men of the same age but with only average incomes?

text: 40岁男不买房不买好车，多少能有点存款，去越南找妹子不要太简单。
en: A 40-year-old man who doesn't buy a flat or a fancy car, and has at least some savings, can go to Vietnam to find a girl with absurd ease.

text: 网上的意淫，约等于一群口袋里掏不出二百块的大学生，在讨论该买什么车。
en: The fantasies online are roughly equivalent to a bunch of university students who can't even pull two hundred yuan out of their pockets, debating which car to buy.

text: BBA都是垃圾，劳斯莱斯，兰博基尼，法拉利也才勉勉强强。
en: BBA are rubbish; even Rolls-Royce, Lamborghini and Ferrari are only just about acceptable.

text: 现实中，40岁男人喜欢40岁女人的很多。
en: In reality, many 40-year-old men like 40-year-old women.

text: 我讲个我身边的例子。
en: Let me tell you an example from close to home.

text: 去年到一个木雕馆逛过，然后和店里的女馆长聊得很尽兴，之后加了联系方式。
en: Last year I visited a woodcarving gallery and had a very enjoyable chat with the female curator there, after which we exchanged contact details.

text: 女馆长43岁，身材和脸都不错，离异不离家。
en: The female curator was 43, with a good figure and face, divorced but not having left the home.

text: 我们经常一起吃饭聊天。
en: We often ate and chatted together.

text: 我对她自然也是有想法的。
en: Naturally, I had my eye on her too.

text: 但我想说的是女馆长告诉我的事情。
en: But what I want to say is what the curator told me.

text: 女馆长有段时间混迹于我们市里的工艺美术区，还拜了会长当老师。
en: For a time the curator hung around our city's arts-and-crafts district, and even took the association's president as her mentor.

text: 这美术区里，混迹了不少人，都是中年人，男女都有。
en: In this arts district, quite a few people hung around — all middle-aged, both men and women.

text: 有破产老板，主播，大龄it男，老师等。
en: There were bankrupt bosses, live-streamers, older IT men, teachers and so on.

text: 基本都是离异的，年纪都大于40。
en: Basically all were divorced, and all over 40.

text: 这些人每天都是喝茶，然后吃饭，喝酒，吹牛。
en: These people spent every day drinking tea, then eating, drinking alcohol and shooting the breeze.

text: 女馆长参加几次后，腻烦得不行，就不去了。
en: After attending a few times, the curator was thoroughly sick of it and stopped going.

text: 按她说的，那些男人总想灌醉她，还总想动手动脚。
en: According to her, those men were always trying to get her drunk, and always trying to get handsy.

text: 她还有个师姐，是众星捧月般的存在，那群男的都在向她师姐献殷勤。
en: She also had a senior apprentice who was treated like a queen; all those men were courting her favour.

text: 她还说，她师姐和其中不少人都谈过了。
en: She also said her senior apprentice had been involved with quite a few of them.

text: 类似的情节，我也遇见过。
en: I've encountered similar scenarios too.

text: 我同学大货车司机，当时还蛮挣钱的，月入一两万那种，市里全款房子，乡下别墅，有次请我吃饭，让我配合打掩护，他要上同行的一女的。
en: A schoolmate of mine was a lorry driver; at the time he earned quite well, the kind bringing in ten or twenty thousand a month, with a flat bought outright in the city and a villa in the countryside. Once he treated me to a meal and asked me to help cover for him — he wanted to hit on a woman from the same trade.

text: 那女的也三四十了，长得歪瓜裂枣。
en: That woman was also in her thirties or forties, and not much to look at.

text: 还有次在酒局上遇到一个内蒙的女人，长得跟凤凰传奇很像，嫁到我们这边，生了三个孩子，当时正在闹离婚。
en: Another time, at a drinking gathering, I met a woman from Inner Mongolia who looked a lot like Phoenix Legend, had married into our area, borne three children, and was at the time in the middle of a divorce.

text: 那天喝到半夜没酒，她给一个男人打去电话。
en: That night, drinking until midnight, they ran out of alcohol, and she rang a man.

text: 凌晨两点多，一个男人带酒过来。
en: Just after two in the morning, a man arrived with alcohol.

text: 男人还是个老板，经营着一个有些文艺的酒吧烧烤。
en: The man was actually a boss, running a rather artsy barbecue bar with a literary feel.

text: 想象中，是四十岁的女人和二十岁的女孩，各自搂着男人的胳膊，让男人选择谁。
en: In the imagination, it is a forty-year-old woman and a twenty-year-old girl, each linking arms with a man, making him choose between them.

text: 但实际上，四十岁的男人是和二十岁女人玩不到一起的，即使去商k，去洗脚城，遇到的也大概是三十左右的。
en: But in reality, a forty-year-old man can't really hang out with a twenty-year-old woman — even if he goes to a business KTV or a foot-massage parlour, the ones he meets are probably around thirty.
